Name: Custom Obelisks
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
[center][size=5][b][u]Custom Obelisks
[/u][/b][/size]﻿[/center]This framework lets you add your own custom warp obelisks to the Wizard's building menu, as well as your own warp totems via JA.

﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[size=4][b]How does it work?
[/b][/size]This mod works by loading each content pack into a theoretical 'pile' and then sifting through that pile when you open the Wizard's menu, adding each one. It also has to work around Stardew's save serialisation, by using a custom serialisation method that can be seen in more detail in the source code linked below.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ [size=4][b]Can I make a content pack?
[/b][/size]Of course! Look at the documentation listed below for help with creation of a CO content pack. An example pack that adds a Secret Woods Obelisk is also listed on the files tab for your usage.


﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[u]Installation[/u]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ [size=4]1. Download this mod and all of its dependencies from the Nexus files tab.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿2. Drag all the mod folders into your 'Mods' folder.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿3. Enjoy!

[/size][url=https://github.com/XxHarvzBackxX/Custom-Obelisks]Source code.[/url]
[url=https://github.com/XxHarvzBackxX/Custom-Obelisks/blob/main/Content-Pack-Guide.md]Content pack creation guide.[/url]
